name: A Conqueror's Crown
summary: Warug wants a Conqueror’s Crown from a crypt in the Badlands for the Magram. In return, he promises to reveal the clan’s greatest strength.

sections.title: Warug’s Demand
sections.body: Warug seeks a crown for the Magram in Magram Village. He says the strongest centaur clan deserves armaments equal to its might, and names the Badlands as the place to search. You are to bring the crown back while keeping your standing with the Magram; Warug has promised a revelation in return.

faq.answer: Warug in Magram Village wants the Conqueror’s Crown for the Magram.

faq.q: Where is the crown said to be?
faq.answer: Warug says to search a crypt in the Badlands.

faq.q: Why does Warug want a crown?
faq.answer: Warug says the strongest centaur clan deserves armaments as fierce as its strength, and that he needs the crown most of all.

faq.q: What does Warug promise in return?
faq.answer: Warug promises to reveal the Magram’s greatest strength.

faq.q: What must I maintain while seeking the crown?
faq.answer: You need to maintain your reputation with the Magram while seeking the crown.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Conqueror's Crown
